title: Convolution quadrature based on a truncated trapezoidal rule
summary: We study the truncated trapezoidal rule, a family of A-stable second order multistep methods parametrized by an integer $J \ge 2$, a compromise between BDF2 and the trapezoidal rule. We obtain a closed-form expression for the coefficients that minimize the principal error constant under the A-stability constraint and we derive an explicit formula for the corresponding principal error constant.
